Always use this skill whenever the user wants any kind of chart, graph, diagram, or visual representation of data — including explicit requests (\"make a bar chart\", \"show a pie chart\") and implicit ones (\"compare these numbers\", \"show the trend\", \"draw a flowchart\", \"create a mind map\", \"visualize this data\"). Use it even when the user just shares data and visualization is helpful for user to understand the data. Supports 17+ types including column, bar, line, pie, area, scatter, radar, histogram, network graph, mind map, flow diagram, org chart, and more. Output format is vis-chart markdown code blocks.\n---\n\n# GPTVis Charts\n\n## Workflow\n\n**IMPORTANT: Follow this workflow to minimize context usage and maximize efficiency:**\n\n1. **Analyze user request** - Understand what data needs to be visualized\n2. **Select chart type** - Use the Chart Type Selection Guide below to determine the most appropriate chart type\n3. **Load detailed syntax** - Read ONLY the specific reference file for the selected chart type from `references/` directory. Note that you MUST read specific reference file for all charts except column/pie/line. !!!!\n4. **Generate chart** - Create the ```vis-chart code block using the loaded syntax\n\n**Do NOT load all reference files at once. Only load what you need for the specific chart type.**\n\n## Chart Type Selection Guide\n\n### Quick Chart Type Reference\n\n**Statistical Charts:**\n- `column` - Vertical bars for comparing categories (read `references/Column_Chart.md`)\n- `bar` - Horizontal bars for comparing categories with long names (read `references/Bar_Chart.md`)\n- `line` - Trends over time or ordered data (read `references/Line_Chart.md`)\n- `pie` - Part-to-whole proportions, ≤5 categories (read `references/Pie_Chart.md`)\n- `area` - Trends with volume emphasis (read `references/Area_Chart.md`)\n- `scatter` - Correlation between two variables (read `references/Scatter_Chart.md`)\n- `histogram` - Frequency distribution (read `references/Histogram_Chart.md`)\n- `boxplot` - Statistical summaries (read `references/Boxplot.md`)\n- `radar` - Multi-dimensional comparisons (read `references/Radar_Chart.md`)\n- `dualaxes` - Two metrics with different scales (read `references/DualAxes_Chart.md`)\n- `funnel` - Conversion funnels (read `references/Funnel_Chart.md`)\n- `sankey` - Flow between stages (read `references/Sankey_Chart.md`)\n- `wordcloud` - Text frequency (read `references/WordCloud_Chart.md`)\n\n**Relationship & Hierarchy Charts:**\n- `network` - Entity connections (read `references/Network_Graph.md`)\n- `mindmap` - Hierarchical concepts (read `references/Mind_Map.md`)\n- `flow` - Process steps (read `references/Flow_Diagram.md`)\n- `fishbone` - Cause-and-effect (read `references/Fishbone_Diagram.md`)\n- `organization` - Org structures (read `references/Organization_Chart.md`)\n\n\n### Selection Criteria by Purpose\n\n**For Comparisons:**\n- Comparing categories → `column` or `bar`\n- Multiple series across categories → `column` with `group: true`\n- Multi-dimensional comparison → `radar`\n\n**For Trends:**\n- Time series where X-axis contains actual time points → `line` (requires ≥3 points per group)\n- X-axis is categories, not time → `column` (not `line`)\n- Trends with volume → `area`\n- Two metrics with different scales → `dualaxes`\n\n**For Composition:**\n- Part-to-whole (≤5 parts) → `pie`\n- Composition over time → stacked `column`/`bar`/`area`\n- Hierarchical composition → `treemap`\n\n**For Distribution:**\n- Frequency distribution → `histogram`\n- Statistical summary → `boxplot`\n- Two-variable correlation → `scatter`\n\n**For Relationships:**\n- Entity connections → `network`\n- Hierarchical concepts → `mindmap`\n- Process flows → `flow`\n- Flow quantities → `sankey`\n\n\n### Financial Data Scenarios\n\n**Common financial visualizations:**\n- Stock price trends → `line`\n- Capital flows → `line` or `area`\n- Quarterly comparisons → `column`\n- Portfolio allocation → `pie`\n- P/E ratios correlation → `scatter`\n- Return distributions → `histogram` or `boxplot`\n- Multi-metric performance → `radar`\n- Short selling analysis → `dualaxes`\n\n\n## Chart Generation Rules\n\nThese rules prevent common rendering failures:\n\n**Data values:** Use pure numbers only — no \"约\", no \"±\", no \"~\", no unit suffixes inside data fields. Units belong in `title`, `axisXTitle`, or `axisYTitle` only.\n\n**Scale normalization:** Normalize large numbers so absolute values stay readable. For example, 1,500,000,000 → 1.5, with title saying \"（亿元）\". Never mix two very different scales in one chart (e.g., one series around 500 and another around 0.05) — split into two charts or use `dualaxes`.\n\n**Code block:** Always close the code block with a terminating ` ``` `. Never add comments inside chart JSON. Never use special formats like `[stock xxx]` inside data.\n\n**Chart type discipline:** Only use the chart types listed in this skill. Do not invent new types.\n\n**Use charts generously:** When the user shares data or asks analytical questions, proactively choose the most informative chart rather than responding with plain text.\n\n## Best practices\n- Time series prioritizes line charts/area charts, while categorical comparisons prioritize bar charts/column charts.\n- Pie charts should have no more than 5 categories. If there are more, it is recommended to merge them into \"Other\" or switch to a bar chart.\n- Do not use pie charts to display trends, and do not use line charts to display unordered categories.\n- Numerical fields must be of numeric type, and categorical fields must be of text type.\n\n## Basic Chart Format\n\nAll GPTVis charts use this structure:\n\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"chart-type\",\n  \"data\": [...],\n  \"title\": \"Chart Title\"\n}\n```\n\nDo not include `theme`, `style`, `backgroundColor`, `palette`, or any other visual styling fields — these are controlled by the host system.\n\n## Common Examples\n\n### Column Chart\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"column\",\n  \"data\": [\n    { \"category\": \"Q1\", \"value\": 120 },\n    { \"category\": \"Q2\", \"value\": 150 }\n  ],\n  \"title\": \"Quarterly Sales\"\n}\n```\n\n### Line Chart\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"line\",\n  \"data\": [\n    { \"time\": \"2024-01\", \"value\": 100 },\n    { \"time\": \"2024-02\", \"value\": 120 }\n  ],\n  \"title\": \"Monthly Trend\"\n}\n```\n\n### Pie Chart\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"pie\",\n  \"data\": [\n    { \"category\": \"Product A\", \"value\": 45 },\n    { \"category\": \"Product B\", \"value\": 30 },\n    { \"category\": \"Product C\", \"value\": 25 }\n  ],\n  \"title\": \"Market Share\"\n}\n```\n\n### dual-axes Chart\n```vis-chart\n{\"type\":\"dual-axes\",\"categories\":[\"2018\",\"2019\",\"2020\",\"2021\",\"2022\"],\"title\":\"2018-2022销售额与利润率\",\"axisXTitle\":\"年份\",\"series\":[{\"type\":\"column\",\"data\":[91.9,99.1,101.6,114.4,121],\"axisYTitle\":\"销售额\"},{\"type\":\"line\",\"data\":[0.055,0.06,0.062,0.07,0.075],\"axisYTitle\":\"利润率\"}]}\n```\n\n## definitions\n- All required and optional fields\n- Data structure requirements\n- Multiple usage examples\n- Chinese descriptions and use cases\n\n**Example workflow:**\n1. Horizontal bars for comparing categories with long names (read `references/Bar_Chart.md`)\n- `line` - Trends over time or ordered data (read `references/Line_Chart.md`)\n- `pie` - Part-to-whole proportions, ≤5 categories (read `references/Pie_Chart.md`)\n- `area` - Trends with volume emphasis (read `references/Area_Chart.md`)\n- `scatter` - Correlation between two variables (read `references/Scatter_Chart.md`)\n- `histogram` - Frequency distribution (read `references/Histogram_Chart.md`)\n- `boxplot` - Statistical summaries (read `references/Boxplot.md`)\n- `radar` - Multi-dimensional comparisons (read `references/Radar_Chart.md`)\n- `dualaxes` - Two metrics with different scales (read `references/DualAxes_Chart.md`)\n- `funnel` - Conversion funnels (read `references/Funnel_Chart.md`)\n- `sankey` - Flow between stages (read `references/Sankey_Chart.md`)\n- `wordcloud` - Text frequency (read `references/WordCloud_Chart.md`)\n\n**Relationship & Hierarchy Charts:**\n- `network` - Entity connections (read `references/Network_Graph.md`)\n- `mindmap` - Hierarchical concepts (read `references/Mind_Map.md`)\n- `flow` - Process steps (read `references/Flow_Diagram.md`)\n- `fishbone` - Cause-and-effect (read `references/Fishbone_Diagram.md`)\n- `organization` - Org structures (read `references/Organization_Chart.md`)\n\n\n### Selection Criteria by Purpose\n\n**For Comparisons:**\n- Comparing categories → `column` or `bar`\n- Multiple series across categories → `column` with `group: true`\n- Multi-dimensional comparison → `radar`\n\n**For Trends:**\n- Time series where X-axis contains actual time points → `line` (requires ≥3 points per group)\n- X-axis is categories, not time → `column` (not `line`)\n- Trends with volume → `area`\n- Two metrics with different scales → `dualaxes`\n\n**For Composition:**\n- Part-to-whole (≤5 parts) → `pie`\n- Composition over time → stacked `column`/`bar`/`area`\n- Hierarchical composition → `treemap`\n\n**For Distribution:**\n- Frequency distribution → `histogram`\n- Statistical summary → `boxplot`\n- Two-variable correlation → `scatter`\n\n**For Relationships:**\n- Entity connections → `network`\n- Hierarchical concepts → `mindmap`\n- Process flows → `flow`\n- Flow quantities → `sankey`\n\n\n### Financial Data Scenarios\n\n**Common financial visualizations:**\n- Stock price trends → `line`\n- Capital flows → `line` or `area`\n- Quarterly comparisons → `column`\n- Portfolio allocation → `pie`\n- P/E ratios correlation → `scatter`\n- Return distributions → `histogram` or `boxplot`\n- Multi-metric performance → `radar`\n- Short selling analysis → `dualaxes`\n\n\n## Chart Generation Rules\n\nThese rules prevent common rendering failures:\n\n**Data values:** Use pure numbers only — no \"约\", no \"±\", no \"~\", no unit suffixes inside data fields. Units belong in `title`, `axisXTitle`, or `axisYTitle` only.\n\n**Scale normalization:** Normalize large numbers so absolute values stay readable. For example, 1,500,000,000 → 1.5, with title saying \"（亿元）\". Never mix two very different scales in one chart (e.g., one series around 500 and another around 0.05) — split into two charts or use `dualaxes`.\n\n**Code block:** Always close the code block with a terminating ` ``` `. Never add comments inside chart JSON. Never use special formats like `[stock xxx]` inside data.\n\n**Chart type discipline:** Only use the chart types listed in this skill. Do not invent new types.\n\n**Use charts generously:** When the user shares data or asks analytical questions, proactively choose the most informative chart rather than responding with plain text.\n\n## Best practices\n- Time series prioritizes line charts/area charts, while categorical comparisons prioritize bar charts/column charts.\n- Pie charts should have no more than 5 categories. If there are more, it is recommended to merge them into \"Other\" or switch to a bar chart.\n- Do not use pie charts to display trends, and do not use line charts to display unordered categories.\n- Numerical fields must be of numeric type, and categorical fields must be of text type.\n\n## Basic Chart Format\n\nAll GPTVis charts use this structure:\n\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"chart-type\",\n  \"data\": [...],\n  \"title\": \"Chart Title\"\n}\n```\n\nDo not include `theme`, `style`, `backgroundColor`, `palette`, or any other visual styling fields — these are controlled by the host system.\n\n## Common Examples\n\n### Column Chart\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"column\",\n  \"data\": [\n    { \"category\": \"Q1\", \"value\": 120 },\n    { \"category\": \"Q2\", \"value\": 150 }\n  ],\n  \"title\": \"Quarterly Sales\"\n}\n```\n\n### Line Chart\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"line\",\n  \"data\": [\n    { \"time\": \"2024-01\", \"value\": 100 },\n    { \"time\": \"2024-02\", \"value\": 120 }\n  ],\n  \"title\": \"Monthly Trend\"\n}\n```\n\n### Pie Chart\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"pie\",\n  \"data\": [\n    { \"category\": \"Product A\", \"value\": 45 },\n    { \"category\": \"Product B\", \"value\": 30 },\n    { \"category\": \"Product C\", \"value\": 25 }\n  ],\n  \"title\": \"Market Share\"\n}\n```\n\n### dual-axes 图表属性\n\n- 名称：双轴图\n- 别名：组合图，英文名：DualAxes Chart\n- 形状：柱形、折线\n- 图表类别：组合图表\n- 图表功能：多维度比较、趋势分析\n\n## 基础概念\n\n双轴图是一种结合两个不同图表类型的组合图表，通常是将柱状图与折线图结合起来显示。双轴图通过在一个图表中使用两个垂直 Y 轴（左侧和右侧），分别对应不同的数值维度。柱状图用于展示一组数据的大小或数量，而折线图则展示另一组数据的趋势。双轴图非常适合同时展示不同类型的数据变化趋势。\n\n## 适用场景\n\n- 同时展示两个具有不同数量级的数据，例如销售额和增长率。\n- 比较两组变量的相对变化趋势，如同时观察某时间段内的销量和利润率。\n- 数据维度不同且具有共同的 X 轴（例如时间、类别）。\n\n## 不适用场景\n\n- 数据类型相同且数量级相近时，单一类型图表（如折线图或柱状图）更简洁。\n- 无法找到具有相关性的两个数据维度进行比较时，双轴图的价值会降低。\n\n## 图表用法\n\n### 图表属性\n\n```typescript\ntype DualAxes = {\n  type: 'dual-axes';\n  categories: string[];\n  title?: string;\n  axisXTitle?: string;\n  series: SeriesDataItem[];\n};\n\ntype SeriesDataItem = {\n  type: 'line' | 'column';\n  data: number[];\n  axisYTitle?: string;\n};\n```\n\n### 数据要求\n\n- type：图表的类型，必填，文本类型，值必须为 \"dual-axes\"。\n- categories：图表的 X 轴的数组，必填，数组文本类型。\n- title：图表的标题，选填，文本类型。\n- axisXTitle：图表的 X 轴的标题，选填，文本类型。\n- series：图表详细组合，必填，数组对象类型，每个对象代表一个基础图表，包含：\n  - type：基础图表的类型，必填，\"column\"表示柱状图，\"line\"表示折线图；\n  - data：基础图表的数据，必填，数组数值类型；\n  - axisYTitle：基础图表的 Y 轴标题，选填，文本类型；\n\n## 使用示例\n\n1. 用双轴图展示某公司的年销售额与利润率，2018 年至 2022 年的销售额分别为 91.9 亿、99.1 亿、101.6 亿、114.4 亿、121 亿，利润率分别为 5.5%、6.0%、6.2%、7.0%、7.5%。\n\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"dual-axes\",\n  \"categories\": [\"2018\", \"2019\", \"2020\", \"2021\", \"2022\"],\n  \"title\": \"2018-2022销售额与利润率\",\n  \"axisXTitle\": \"年份\",\n  \"series\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"column\",\n      \"data\": [91.9, 99.1, 101.6, 114.4, 121],\n      \"axisYTitle\": \"销售额\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"line\",\n      \"data\": [0.055, 0.06, 0.062, 0.07, 0.075],\n      \"axisYTitle\": \"利润率\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n2. 用双轴图可视化我的数据 [{ \"year\": 2020, \"revenue\": 500, \"growth_rate\": 10 }, { \"year\": 2021, \"revenue\": 600, \"growth_rate\": 12 }, { \"year\": 2022, \"revenue\": 700, \"growth_rate\": 15 }]。\n\n```vis-chart\n{\n  \"type\": \"dual-axes\",\n  \"categories\": [\"2020\", \"2021\", \"2022\"],\n  \"title\": \"2020-2022 Income and Growth Rate\",\n  \"axisXTitle\": \"Year\",\n  \"series\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"column\",\n      \"data\": [500, 600, 700],\n      \"axisYTitle\": \"Income\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"line\",\n      \"data\": [10, 12, 15],\n      \"axisYTitle\": \"Growth Rate\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n3. 用组合图可视化我的数据 [{ \"day\":
